en.title: Internships and Attachments at Public Institutions like TRA
en.summary: Field attachments and internships let students learn real work. Here is what TRA's website confirms about recruitment and training, plus practical tips for seeking a placement.
objectives: Explain the difference between an attachment and an internship
Identify official TRA channels for opportunities and training
Prepare a professional request for a placement
en.keywords: internship, field attachment, practical training, TRA, public institutions, vacancies, ITA
en.body_markdown:
## Attachments and internships

A **field attachment** (practical training) is usually part of a college or university course: students spend a period working in an organisation to apply what they learn. An **internship** is often for recent graduates and helps them gain work experience. Both are valuable for anyone interested in tax, accounting, ICT, law or customs work.

## What TRA's website confirms

- TRA, like other government institutions, **publicly advertises job vacancies** through newspapers, the official TRA website and official social media, and allows applicants to **apply online** when positions are announced.
- The TRA website has a **Vacancies** page. Check it regularly; when nothing is open, it asks you to check back later.
- TRA offices are located nationwide, in every region, district, business centre and official border post.
- TRA's Client Service Charter lists **Training and Taxpayers' Education** among TRA's services, and lists recognised tax programmes at the **Institute of Tax Administration (ITA)**, from Certificate (1 year) to Masters (2 years).
- Tax Club members are encouraged to **visit TRA offices** to increase their tax knowledge.

TRA's website does not publish a dedicated internship or attachment programme page, so rely only on official TRA announcements for any placement opportunity.

## How to seek a placement (general advice)

1. **Start early.** Speak to your college attachment coordinator months before the placement period.
2. **Prepare documents:** a short CV, an introduction letter from your college and copies of your identification.
3. **Write a polite request letter** addressed to the head of the office, stating your course, the period and the skills you hope to build.
4. **Follow official channels only.** Never pay anyone who promises to "secure" a placement or job. Report such offers.
5. **Be professional during the placement:** arrive on time, dress neatly, keep information confidential and ask questions.

## Making the most of your placement

Keep a daily logbook of tasks, ask your supervisor for feedback, and request a reference letter at the end. These will strengthen future applications.

## Key points

- Attachments are part of a course; internships often follow graduation.
- TRA advertises opportunities publicly and accepts online applications when positions are announced.
- Use only official TRA channels and never pay for a placement.
- Professional behaviour and confidentiality matter in public institutions.

Source: [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.tra.go.tz/faq); [Vacancies](https://www.tra.go.tz/vacancies); [Client's Service Charter (PDF)](https://www.tra.go.tz/images/uploads/pages/CLIENT_SERVICE_CHARTER.pdf); [TRA Tax Club Corner](https://www.tra.go.tz/tax-club)

sw.title: Mafunzo kwa Vitendo na Uzoefu Kazini katika Taasisi za Umma kama TRA
sw.summary: Mafunzo kwa vitendo na programu za uzoefu kazini huwawezesha wanafunzi kujifunza kazi halisi. Haya ndiyo tovuti ya TRA inathibitisha kuhusu ajira na mafunzo, pamoja na vidokezo vya kutafuta nafasi.
objectives: Kueleza tofauti kati ya mafunzo kwa vitendo na programu ya uzoefu kazini (internship)
Kutambua vyanzo rasmi vya TRA vya fursa na mafunzo
Kuandaa ombi la nafasi kwa weledi
sw.keywords: internship, mafunzo kwa vitendo, field attachment, TRA, taasisi za umma, nafasi za kazi, ITA
sw.body_markdown:
## Mafunzo kwa vitendo na uzoefu kazini

**Mafunzo kwa vitendo (field attachment)** kwa kawaida ni sehemu ya kozi ya chuo: wanafunzi hukaa muda fulani katika taasisi ili kutumia wanachojifunza. **Programu ya uzoefu kazini (internship)** mara nyingi ni kwa wahitimu wapya ili wapate uzoefu wa kazi. Zote ni muhimu kwa yeyote anayependa kazi za kodi, uhasibu, TEHAMA, sheria au forodha.

## Tovuti ya TRA inathibitisha nini

- TRA, kama taasisi nyingine za Serikali, **inatangaza ajira kwa uwazi** kupitia magazeti, tovuti rasmi ya TRA na mitandao rasmi ya kijamii, na huruhusu waombaji **kuomba mtandaoni** nafasi zinapotangazwa.
- Tovuti ya TRA ina ukurasa wa **Vacancies (Nafasi za Kazi)**. Utembelee mara kwa mara; pasipo nafasi, hukuomba uangalie tena baadaye.
- Ofisi za TRA zipo nchi nzima, katika kila mkoa, wilaya, vituo vya biashara na vituo rasmi vya mipakani.
- Mkataba wa Huduma kwa Mteja wa TRA unataja **Mafunzo na Elimu kwa Mlipakodi** kama mojawapo ya huduma za TRA, na unaorodhesha programu za kodi zinazotambuliwa za **Chuo Cha Usimamizi Wa Kodi (ITA)**, kuanzia Cheti (mwaka 1) hadi Shahada ya Uzamili (miaka 2).
- Wanachama wa Klabu za Kodi wanahimizwa **kutembelea ofisi za TRA** ili kuongeza maarifa ya kodi.

Tovuti ya TRA haina ukurasa maalum wa programu ya mafunzo kwa vitendo au internship, hivyo tegemea matangazo rasmi ya TRA pekee kwa fursa yoyote.

## Jinsi ya kutafuta nafasi (ushauri wa jumla)

1. **Anza mapema.** Ongea na mratibu wa mafunzo kwa vitendo wa chuo chako miezi kadhaa kabla.
2. **Andaa nyaraka:** CV fupi, barua ya utambulisho kutoka chuoni na nakala za kitambulisho.
3. **Andika barua ya ombi kwa heshima** kwa mkuu wa ofisi, ukieleza kozi yako, kipindi na ujuzi unaotarajia kujenga.
4. **Tumia njia rasmi tu.** Usimlipe mtu yeyote anayeahidi "kukutafutia" nafasi au kazi. Ripoti ofa kama hizo.
5. **Kuwa na weledi wakati wa mafunzo:** fika kwa wakati, vaa nadhifu, tunza siri za taarifa na uliza maswali.

## Kunufaika zaidi na mafunzo yako

Tunza daftari la kila siku la kazi ulizofanya, omba maoni kwa msimamizi wako, na omba barua ya utambulisho (reference) mwishoni. Hizi zitaimarisha maombi yako ya baadaye.

## Mambo muhimu

- Mafunzo kwa vitendo ni sehemu ya kozi; internship mara nyingi hufuata baada ya kuhitimu.
- TRA hutangaza fursa kwa uwazi na hupokea maombi mtandaoni nafasi zinapotangazwa.
- Tumia njia rasmi za TRA pekee na usilipe ili kupata nafasi.
- Weledi na usiri ni muhimu katika taasisi za umma.
